title: Gravity's Grateful Transition: A New Chapter for Growth and Collaboration

posts.cooked:
Dear TEC Community,

We, at Gravity, would like to express our deepest gratitude to the Token Engineering Commons (TEC) for providing the fertile soil that allowed our project to grow and flourish. As a trust creation and conflict management initiative born from the TEC, we have been privileged to learn, share, and evolve within this supportive and nurturing environment.

However, we recognize that growth often requires change. After much deliberation and in the spirit of continued expansion, we have decided to embark on a new phase for Gravity. This involves transitioning our operations to our own dedicated Gravity DAO Discord server. Please note that this move does not signify that we are turning our back on the TEC. On the contrary, we believe this proactive step will enable our project to grow further, position its goodwill, and ultimately develop nested enterprises that contribute to the broader token engineering ecosystem. If you want to know more about our services, please read this blog post.

By establishing dedicated platforms, Gravity will be able to focus on its core mission of providing conflict management and trust creation services for decentralized organizations, while still maintaining strong ties with the TEC community. We believe that this separation will benefit both Gravity and the TEC, as it will allow for more efficient communication, specialized development, and targeted outreach to the communities we serve.

We want to assure the TEC community that our collaboration and commitment remain steadfast. We will continue to exchange knowledge, resources, and support as we collectively advance the field of token engineering. This new chapter for Gravity is a testament to the incredible progress we have made together, and we are excited to explore the opportunities that lie ahead in our continued partnership.

We invite you to join us on our new Discord server, to check our page, and to grab some swag. Your support and collaboration have been instrumental in our growth, and we look forward to nurturing our relationship with the TEC as we embark on this exciting new phase.

With immense gratitude and anticipation for the future,

Juan Carlos, on behalf of the Gravity DAO Team
